title: Sensor Boundary Readiness
plain_reading: A chip-only result is incomplete if the cost of getting real-world signals into the model is ignored.
what_this_supports: The review can show whether camera, event, tactile, audio, or industrial sensor costs are included.
what_this_does_not_prove: It does not prove sensor-to-action latency without synchronized traces.
next_actions: Tie sensor evidence to task and runtime evidence.
